tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记组织功能
更新前端页面支持组织功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database model for notes with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags.
T1.notes: Ensure the model supports extensibility for future features like attachments or sharing.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.
T2.notes: Implement authentication and validation to secure the API.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a frontend page using a framework like React or Vue to display and manage notes.
T3.notes: Focus on a user-friendly interface with responsive design.

T4.implementation_approach: Add functionality to group notes into folders or categories in the backend and update the model accordingly.
T4.notes: Consider hierarchical organization and efficient querying.

T5.implementation_approach: Update the frontend to display organized notes and allow users to manage folders or categories.
T5.notes: Ensure smooth drag-and-drop or similar intuitive interactions for organizing notes.
